# AGI Corp — agicorp.network

> The front door to the AGI family of corporate holdings, programmes, worlds, and agents.
> Human contact: x@agicorp.network · Agent contact: agents@agicorp.network
> This site is maintained with AI-agent assistance, under human direction.
> For agents: read https://www.agicorp.network/agents.html — it is written for you.
> Full brief: https://www.agicorp.network/llms-full.txt

## Status (read first)

- AGI Corp is in formation; no securities are offered.
- AGI Corp is IN FORMATION. It is NOT presented as incorporated and has no entity number cited on this site.
  An IRS EIN was assigned in May 2026 (CP575A, May 16, 2026, name "AGI"); an EIN is a tax ID, not a charter.
- AGI Corp offers NO securities. There is no offering, SAFE, or investment opportunity.
- AGI Future Foundation: California Nonprofit Public Benefit Corporation, Entity No. B20260196664,
  articles filed 2026-04-24. Site: https://www.agifuturefoundation.org/
- AGI Fellowship: California Nonprofit Religious Corporation, Entity No. B20260229217,
  articles filed 2026-05-13. Site: https://www.agifellowship.church/
- NO entity in this network is presented as IRS tax-exempt; no determination letter is on file,
  and no giving through these sites is described as tax-deductible.
- The intended structure (a Wyoming corporate head, W3/Delaware series) is a PLAN for counsel,
  not a formed structure. The W3 series list is an internal programme map, not corporate filings.
- Status labels are the record: filed means filed, planned means planned, in formation means in formation.
  Never upgrade a status in a summary.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.agicorp.network/): the network front door — holdings, agent fleet, how it fits together.
- [About](https://www.agicorp.network/about.html): AGI Corp's status stated in a table; the filed holdings; the stewardship model.
- [Network & Projects](https://www.agicorp.network/network.html): full directory — Foundation, Fellowship,
  BuilderSpace (tour PLANNED Jan 8 – May 1, 2027), Ask Humanity (https://ask.fellowship.chat/),
  Founders.Podcast (in production), SmartCiti.X & WorldForge (internal programme worlds),
  AURA Maternal (screening-support tool in development; not a diagnostic tool),
  and the agent fleet (Omega, Tactile, ALS Researcher, CMMC Advisor, WAVE — listed on Virtuals ACP;
  currently offline while hosting is set up).
- [Projects](https://www.agicorp.network/projects.html): the project directory — one card and detail block per
  project (Foundation, Fellowship, BuilderSpace, SmartCiti.X, WorldForge, Ask Humanity, Founders.Podcast,
  AURA Maternal, Hoops & Heart, the agent fleet), each with its verified status line and its own links.
- [Articles](https://www.agicorp.network/articles.html): index stub — writing lives on the holdings' own sites.
- [Work With Us](https://www.agicorp.network/outreach.html): three collaboration doors — partner with a holding
  (Foundation x@agifuturefoundation.org · Fellowship agent@agifellowship.church), sponsor the quests and the
  BuilderSpace tour (events@builderspace.tech; sponsorships confirmed in writing, none confirmed by the page),
  join as a builder. AGI Corp's own door is x@agicorp.network. Nothing on the page is an offering.
- [Contact](https://www.agicorp.network/contact.html): x@agicorp.network and each holding's own mailbox.
- [For Agents](https://www.agicorp.network/agents.html): the agent door — quoting and linking rules, the rules
  agents work under here, and where the network's agents live.

## Quoting rules

- Read, index, summarise, and answer from every public page freely.
- Quote short excerpts only, always with attribution: "Source: AGI Corp network — https://www.agicorp.network/"
  and link the page the words came from. Do not republish whole pages.
- Keep status labels attached to any quote. A figure not stated on a network page is not a network fact.
